positions.description:
Lifecycle of dual front-end Web apps

 - Tech Lead on projects, TinyMCE plugins, Lunch n Learns

Infrastructure

 - Docker composition

 - ES6/7, Babel, React, Redux, ReduxSagas, Immutable, Webpack, PostCSS,  ESLint, Prettier, i18n, 
 - Storybook, Jest, Enzyme, Sinon

positions.title: Sr. Front End Engineer
positions.description:
• Engineering Web SPA www.vevo.com
• Tech Lead Project teams, segmenting/delegating project components and milestones.
• Lead web platform team to uninterrupted Continuous Integration for 14 weeks
• Conceptualize, Architect, and Unit test new features working with Product/Design teams. 

Concepts
Universal/Isomorphic, Mobile First, Unit Tests, Continuous Integration, Continuous Deployment, Object-Oriented, Reusable Components

Tools
Node.js, NPM, Git, Express, React, Redux, GraphQL
Webpack, Gulp, Eslint, PostCSS(scss), Babel, Apollo
Deployment: AWS, CircleCI, Jenkins, TeamCIty, GoCD
Testing: Karma, Mocha, Chai, Enzyme

positions.title: Webmaster II
positions.description:
- Work with 3rd party web design agencies to ensure adherence to our web development guidelines and standards and proper integration with our content management systems.
- Deploy web sites from staging to production environment.
- Integrate HTML/CSS/JavaScript and 3rd party APIs into our content management systems.
- Working with global teams to implement analytics tagging. (GA, Adobe, DFA, TMS)
- Responsible for day-to-day site maintenance on multiple web sites.
- Develop and Maintain small web applications in PHP via LAMP stack.
- Lead QA process for multiple websites.
- Advise on the improvement, results, competition and new direction in technology to assist with marketing of Ubisoft brands.
- Work with European counterparts to document web best practices and web development standards.
- Support global web teams in all online channels including CRM, Marketing, Game-to-Web, and Uplay. 
- Global language localization.
- SEO and SEM.
- Manage and Maintain 800-1000 sites across 12 countries.

positions.title: Webmaster I
positions.description:
I Work with 3rd party web design agencies to ensure adherence to our web development guidelines and standards and proper integration with our content management systems. Deploy web sites from staging to production environment. Integrate HTML and Flash website files with our content management system. Responsible for day-to-day site maintenance on multiple web sites internationally. Develop and Maintain and small web applications in PHP.
Lead QA process for multiple websites.
Advise on the improvement, results, competition and new direction in technology to assist with marketing of our brands. Work with our European counterparts to document web best practices and web development standards.

positions.title: Creator, Designer, Programmer
positions.description:
Chesslike: Adventures in Chess is a browser-based, and mobile game developed by me during my free time and on the weekends. It is playable online from any device, and available in the Google Play Store.

Play Now - http://chesslike.net
Google Play - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.mooreinteractive.chesslike 
Game Page - http://moore-interactive.net/games/chesslike/

Chesslike takes the familiarity of chess and takes it on a dungeon-crawling adventure. With Swords, Shields, Warp tiles, and Locked doors, this isn't your grandpa's chess game. When you've had your fill of the puzzles and dungeons, check otu the level editor to make new puzzles for other players to enjoy!

Created with: HTML5, Javascript, CSS3, PHP, MySQL, JSON, CocoonJS, Photoshop, Illustrator
